title: Кібератака на користувачів системи DELTA з використанням шкідливих програм RomCom/FateGrab/StealDeal (CERT-UA#5709)

entities.name: UAC-0142
entities.gloss: A threat group tracked by CERT-UA targeting Ukrainian military entities with RomCom and data stealers.

entities.name: UAC-0132
entities.gloss: A threat actor cluster tracked by CERT-UA with operational similarities to UAC-0142.

entities.name: Центр інновацій та розвитку оборонних технологій Міністерства оборони України
entities.gloss: A defense innovation subdivision of the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine.

entities.name: Міністерство оборони України
entities.gloss: The central government executive body of Ukraine overseeing national defense.

entities.name: DELTA
entities.gloss: A situational awareness and defense management software system used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

entities.name: ОУВ "Запоріжжя"
entities.gloss: An operational group of troops within the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

entities.name: VMProtect
entities.gloss: A software tool for protecting executable code through virtualization and obfuscation.

entities.name: certificates_rootca.zip
entities.gloss: A malicious ZIP archive containing an executable masquerading as a certificate update.

entities.name: certificates_rootCA.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable dropped from a ZIP archive to deploy malware.

entities.name: ais.exe
entities.gloss: An executable file dropped during infection to simulate a certificate installation process.

entities.name: RomCom
entities.gloss: A modular backdoor malware family used for command execution and secondary payload deployment.

entities.name: FateGrab
entities.gloss: A malware tool designed to steal documents and files and exfiltrate them via FTP.

entities.name: StealDeal
entities.gloss: A malware tool designed to collect and exfiltrate web browser credentials and history.

entities.name: delta.mil.gov.ua.delta-storages[.]com
entities.gloss: A spoofed domain used to distribute malicious certificate update archives.

entities.name: delta-storages[.]com
entities.gloss: A malicious domain registered to facilitate credential harvesting and malware distribution.

entities.name: hexactor[.]com
entities.gloss: A command and control domain used by RomCom malware.
An IP address used for network communications and FTP exfiltration in the attack.
